name: Custom / Expanded Dictionary
description: Replaces the game's word list. Point it at your own plain-text file (one word per line) to play with any dictionary you like, or leave it blank for the bundled ~300k-word list. Front-coded into data/compressed.txt exactly as the engine expects.
author: you

param_spec.label: Word list file (optional)
param_spec.help: Full path to a plain-text file with one word per line. Leave blank to use the bundled ~300k-word list. Words are uppercased, filtered to A-Z, and gated to 3-16 letters.

param_spec.label: Apply 3-16 letter length limit
param_spec.help: The engine only accepts 3-16 letter words; longer/shorter ones are dropped. Leave on.
